environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on ECS Fargate. ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL with rule priority 1 using a custom rule group 'archive-traversal-inspection' that performs body inspection on multipart uploads. The rule uses a RegexPatternSet matching byte sequences corresponding to ZIP local file header path entries containing '../' or '..\' patterns (hex: 2e2e2f and 2e2e5c) within the first 8192 bytes of the request body, with oversize handling set to MATCH. The rule action is BLOCK with custom response code 403. Additionally, the WebACL has a second rule at priority 2 referencing AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_BODY in COUNT mode only (not block). The container runs with a read-only root filesystem except for /tmp, and the EXTRACT_DIR is set to /tmp/extracted which is an emptyDir ephemeral volume not shared with other containers.

waf_rules.name: archive-traversal-inspection
waf_rules.regex_pattern_set: matches 2e2e2f and 2e2e5c byte sequences in raw body

config.filesystem: read-only root filesystem, /tmp is ephemeral emptyDir
config.network: private subnet, ALB in public subnet
